question: Kulik Bird Sanctuary is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raiganj Wildlife sanctuary also popularly known as Kulik bird sanctuary.**
 
• It is located near** Raiganj in Uttar Dinajpur district in the state of West Bengal.**
 
• The bird sanctuary is home to 164 species of birds and some 90,000 to 1,00,000 migratory birds visit the sanctuary every year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **West Bengal:**

 
 
• State Formed: 1st November 1956.
 
• Capital: Kolkata.
 
• Chief Minister: Mamata Banerjee.
 
• Governor: Dr. C.V. Ananda Bose
 
• Official Language: Bengali.
 
• The sorrow of Bengal: Damodar.
 
• City of Palaces and City of Joy - Kolkata.
 
• India's first underground railway system and first metro train service were established in Kolkata.
 
• India's first IIT was set up at Kharagpur.
 
• The Himalayan Mountaineering Institute was established in Darjeeling.
 
• Largest Cantilever bridge in India - Howrah Bridge.
 
• The leading producer of Rice and Jute..
 
• Largest Delta in the world - Sunderbans Delta Kolkata.
 
• Largest Planetarium - Birla Planetarium in Kolkata
